# Glossary

<!-- codeforge:local-only:start -->

Section 1 · Context and objectives

Parent page: [Context and objectives](section-1.md)

<!-- codeforge:local-only:end -->

| Term | Definition | Node | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| ageRange (beneficiary age band) | Derived field computed at creation and stored in `publicDeviceRequests/{id}.ageRange`. Turns the numeric `age` field into a banded string for privacy. | device-requests/dc-age-range | live |
| amputationType (type of amputation) | Medical category describing the beneficiary's limb difference. Selected by the requester in the public form and stored in `private/data.amputationType`. | device-requests/dc-amputation-type | live |
| Archived (flag) | Boolean field `archived` (with `archivedAt`, `archivedBy`) on `deviceRequests/{id}`, applicable only to requests in `completata` or `annullata` status. It is not a status: the status stays unchanged. An archived request is read-only for all "live" writes. | device-requests/dc-archived-flag | draft |
| Firestore backup bucket | Dedicated GCS bucket per project, named `{projectId}-firestore-backups`, EU region, with a 30-day deletion lifecycle. Each export creates a timestamp prefix (`gs://<bucket>/<ISO-timestamp>`). The bucket is external infrastructure, not created by the code. | super-admin/concept-backup-bucket | live |
| Catalog + per-entity index (hybrid model) | Attachment data structure: a top-level catalog `attachments/{id}` holding all metadata, and an index in the owning entity's `attachments` subcollection that references the same id. The `entityCollectionPath` field says where the index lives. The physical file sits in the dedicated `{projectId}-attachments` bucket at `attachments/{entityType}/{entityId}/{attachmentId}/{fileName}`. | attachments/dc-attachment-two-level-index | live |
| Opaque category | Free-form category identifier (string) attached to checklists and templates, used to filter `listTemplates` and to bind a template to an application context (e.g. `devicetype` in the `device-requests` layer). The Organizer core neither knows nor validates its meaning: the consumer alone decides its own value space. | process-organizer-core/concept-opaque-category | live |
| checklistIds | Array field on `deviceRequests/{id}` with the ids of the linked Organizer checklists (max 5). Acts as the membership check for RBAC/access. Replaces the old singular `checklistId` field, with no coexistence. | device-requests/dc-checklist-ids | draft |
| Internal status lifecycle | A `deviceRequest` goes through 19 distinct internal statuses: | device-requests/dc-status-lifecycle | live |
| emailTemplates collection | Firestore collection read by the Firebase "Trigger Email" extension (`firestore-send-email`): the document whose id is the template name holds `subject`, `html` and an optional `text`. Its content is governed by the in-code registry and synchronized forward-only by [[super-admin/cap-email-template-deploy]]. | super-admin/concept-email-templates-collection | live |
| Contact (Contact) | A contact is a person potentially interested in becoming a volunteer, handled in a separate CRM collection (`contacts/{contactId}`). Not yet a platform user. | volunteer-management/dc-contact | live |
| Contact (contacts document) | Document of the Firestore collection `contacts/{contactId}`: a person who asked to be contacted (or imported from CSV, in the volunteer-management domain). When created from the form it holds first name, last name, email/phone, profile, notes, `source`, `origin: contact-form`, initial `status` `new`, privacy consent, `recaptchaScore`, a `deleted` flag (soft delete, `false` at creation) and the timestamps `receivedAt`/`createdAt`/`updatedAt`. `status` transitions and the invitation are handled on the admin side. | contacts/dc-contact-document | live |
| Firestore counter for sequential IDs | Firestore document `counters/deviceRequests` with a `lastId` field (integer). Read and incremented inside the same Firestore transaction that creates `deviceRequests/{id}`, guaranteeing atomicity and no race conditions. | device-requests/dc-counter | live |
| DeviceRequest | Central entity of the platform. Represents the request of a 3D-printed prosthetic device for a beneficiary with a limb difference. | device-requests/dc-device-request | live |
| devicetype (type of prosthetic device) | Identifies the open-source prosthetic device model that will be built. Assigned by the admin during validation (not by the requester). | device-requests/dc-device-type | live |
| Project history event | Document `projects/{id}/events/{eventId}` with `fromStatus`, `toStatus`, `note`, `createdBy`, `timestamp`. Created by every `changeProjectStatus`; a pure note has `fromStatus === toStatus`. | special-projects-initiatives/dc-project-event | live |
| requiresAttention flag | Boolean flag on `deviceRequests/{id}` signalling that the request needs urgent intervention, regardless of status. | device-requests/dc-requires-attention | live |
| GlobalMessage (global system message) | Broadcast communication created by admins, visible according to `target`. Stored in `messages/{messageId}`. | device-requests/dc-global-message | live |
| Family consent forms | Two documents tracked as flags on the request: liability waiver (`waiverAcquired*`) and photo release (`photoReleaseAcquired*`), with date and acquiring admin. Distinct from the public form's `consentPrivacy`. | device-requests/dc-family-consent | draft |
| Checklist share link | Document `checklistShareLinks/{token}` (checklistId, requestId, createdAt, createdBy) with a UUID token, non-expiring and non-revocable, enabling public read-only access to the progress of a single checklist. | device-requests/dc-checklist-share-link | draft |
| Project checklist share link | Document `projectChecklistShareLinks/{token}` (UUID token) tying a checklist to a project for public read-only access to its progress. One per checklist, reused on subsequent requests. | special-projects-initiatives/dc-project-checklist-share-link | live |
| mustSetPassword | Boolean flag in `users/{uid}` indicating whether the user still has to set a password. Set to `true` by `completeRegistration` (email link) and to `false` by `registerWithIntegratedAuth` (Google OAuth). | auth/dc-must-set-password | live |
| oobCode | One-time opaque code generated by Firebase Authentication (`auth.generateSignInWithEmailLink`) and embedded in the email verification link. Acts as the email-address verification token in email-link registration. | auth/dc-oob-code | live |
| Checklist origin | Reference `{type, id}` from the checklist instance to the owning entity (e.g. `{type:'deviceRequest', id:'<requestId>'}`), for bidirectional navigation. Optional and opaque to the core, normalized by `normalizeOrigin`; if absent the field is not written. Used by [[process-organizer-core/cap-my-checklist-items]] to rebuild item provenance. | process-organizer-core/concept-checklist-origin | draft |
| Contact origin | Where a contact came from: `contact-form` (public form) or `csv-import` (implicit value for documents without `origin`). Not to be confused with `source`, an optional tag for the entry channel in the form (e.g. `qr` from the `?src=` parameter). | contacts/dc-contact-origin | live |
| Pending Registration | Firestore document in `pendingRegistrations/{oobCode}` representing an email-link registration awaiting verification. Created by `register`, consumed by `checkRegistration`. | auth/dc-pending-registration | live |
| Contact profile ("Who are you?") | Optional classification declared by the contact. Allowed values: `maker`, `studente`, `docente_scuola`, `universita_ricerca`, `famiglia`, `sanitario`, `associazione_ente`, `azienda_sponsor`, `media`, `altro` (the last one accompanied by `profileOther`, free text). `maker` and `studente` are considered close to volunteering and do not require confirmation for the invitation. | contacts/dc-contact-profile | live |
| Project (project) | Entity `projects/{projectId}` that tracks a technical project, an initiative or an event: title, description, type, status, references to linked checklists and an `events` subcollection with the history. The internal name is "project"; the business domain is "Special Projects and Initiatives". | special-projects-initiatives/dc-project | live |
| publicStatus and publicDeviceRequests collection | `publicStatus` is a **5-value** grouping derived from `mapToPublicStatus(status)` (`utils/mapToPublicStatus.ts`): | device-requests/dc-public-status | live |
| RateLimitEntry | Firestore document in the `rateLimits/{key}` collection that tracks the request frequency of an identity (email or IP) to prevent abuse of the public forms. | security/dc-rate-limit-entry | live |
| reCAPTCHA Assessment | Result of the evaluation of a reCAPTCHA Enterprise token produced by the REST API (`POST /v1/projects/{projectId}/assessments`). Represents Google's judgement of the probability that the current action is performed by a human. | security/dc-recaptcha-assessment | live |
| RequestEvent (events sub-collection) | Every relevant change to a `deviceRequest` creates a document in the sub-collection `deviceRequests/{id}/events/{eventId}` — a **lightweight event sourcing** pattern. | device-requests/dc-request-event | live |
| requestNumber (REQ-XXXXXX) | Human-readable identifier of a device request. Format: `REQ-` + 6 zero-padded digits (e.g. `REQ-000001`, `REQ-000042`). | device-requests/dc-request-number | live |
| Retention (persistent / transient) | Mandatory classification of an attachment: `persistent` (to be kept) or `transient` (temporary). A missing value on legacy attachments is normalized to `persistent`. Editable after upload. The device-request archiving code (`device/archiveDeviceRequest.ts`) uses it as a criterion, but that is outside this scope. | attachments/dc-retention | live |
| Historical template/source reference | Reference stored on a checklist instance when it is created from a source: `fromTemplate` when created from a catalog template, `clonedFrom` when cloned from another instance. It is historical data, not a live dependency — if the source (template or instance) is later modified or deleted, the already-created instance is not affected in any way: no core function recomputes or invalidates these references. | process-organizer-core/concept-historical-template-reference | live |
| SecurityLog | Firestore document in the `securityLogs/{auto-id}` collection that records a security event produced by a Cloud Function. Field schema (all normalized with backend defaults before writing): | security/dc-security-log | live |
| PII separation in the private/data sub-collection | The requester's personal data (PII) is never in the main `deviceRequests/{id}` document but isolated in the sub-collection `deviceRequests/{id}/private/data` (a fixed document with id `'data'`). | device-requests/dc-private-data-separation | live |
| ShipmentRequest | Firestore entity representing a request to ship a parcel by a volunteer (or admin) of the association. It is **separate** from the `deviceRequest` lifecycle: it can be used to ship any material, not only produced prosthetic devices. | shipments/dc-shipment-request | live |
| Short-lived signed URL | V4 URL signed by the runtime service account, valid for 5 minutes, with which the client writes (upload) or reads (download) directly on Cloud Storage without going through the Cloud Function. Issuing it is the only event tracked in `securityLogs`. | attachments/dc-signed-url | live |
| 3D printer (Printer) | A 3D printer is a resource registered by the volunteer in the sub-collection `users/{uid}/printers/{printerId}`. Represents the fleet of machines available for manufacturing prosthetic devices. | volunteer-management/dc-3d-printer | live |
| Project status | One of `new` (default, also for legacy `draft`), `active`, `standby`, `archived`, `closed`. `new`/`active` allow content changes; `standby` allows only notes and status changes; `archived`/`closed` are terminal and block everything except deletion. See [[special-projects-initiatives/cap-project-lifecycle-and-rbac]]. | special-projects-initiatives/dc-project-status | live |
| Checklist item status | Progress status of an item: one of the four values of the v1 model, `'Assegnare'` (initial, set on creation/cloning/instantiation), `'Da iniziare'`, `'In corso'`, `'Completata'`. Validated by `isChecklistItemStatus` in `checklistItemStatus.ts` (shared module). The core attaches no application meaning to the values, but `'Completata'` is the value the gate uses for the `generic`, `numeric` and `purchase` types ([[process-organizer-core/cap-completeness-gate]]); for `boolean` items the status is irrelevant. | process-organizer-core/concept-checklist-item-status | draft |
| superAdmin (user flag) | Boolean field `users/{uid}.superAdmin`. When `true` it enables the platform operations of this domain. It is additive to `role: "admin"` (not a third value of `role`) and is set only by hand in the Firestore console. | super-admin/concept-super-admin-flag | live |
| Item type (type) | Mandatory discriminator of every checklist and template item: `'boolean'`, `'generic'`, `'numeric'` or `'purchase'` (`CHECKLIST_ITEM_TYPES`, `isChecklistItemType`). Determines the completeness rule ([[process-organizer-core/cap-completeness-gate]]) and validation constraints: `purchase` requires `quantity > 0` and accepts an http/https `url`. It has no default on creation; only for historical data lacking `type` does the code assume `generic`. | process-organizer-core/concept-checklist-item-type | draft |
| Project type (projectType) | Free, extensible string assigned at creation (UI default: `progetto`, `iniziativa`, `evento`). Also serves as the opaque category of the checklists created for the project ([[process-organizer-core/concept-opaque-category]]) and as a list filter. | special-projects-initiatives/dc-project-type | live |
| Status transitions allowed to volunteers | Restricted subset of the transitions that a volunteer (non-admin) can perform on a request assigned to them. Encoded in `isAllowedVolunteerTransition` in `changeStatus.ts`. | device-requests/dc-volunteer-transition | live |
| Volunteer | A volunteer is a platform user with `role = "volunteer"` in the `users/{uid}` document. Can be in two main states: | volunteer-management/dc-volunteer | live |
